resources.string: The original app is a Unity IL2CPP project. This shell provides a clean Android surface, navigation, and a local premium state.
Premium is unlocked locally. Billing, RevenueCat, and subscription checks are bypassed in this rebuild.
This feature surface is ready for the next implementation pass.
Native rebuild scaffold • no external billing
Bone hierarchy, part transforms, mouth and palm choices, and JSON animation clips. The original editor is in ChromaToons.CharacterAnimation.ChromaRigEditor.
The app imports custom JSON rig clips. Bone paths, rig type, FPS, and frame keys must match the target RigDefinition.
Timeline, export, and lipsync surfaces from the original media tools are reserved for the next rebuild pass.
Cloud JSON catalogs and ZIP character downloads are represented here as a future integration point.
Original gate: RevenueCatManager (IL2CPP type 5220), BuyProSubscription, RestorePurchases, and encoded entitlement fields. This rebuild uses a local PremiumManager that always returns unlocked.
